captures.description: THE WORK RESOLVES WHOLE FROM ONE RECORD: From a single Zenodo record the surface reconstructs Reading a Book with Lee (#440) correctly — the 57 minutes, the 4.5-hour film, Gemini's analysis, the unnamed book — and credits Wells with concept and scripts as the work does.

atoms.evidence: Sparrow Wells is credited as a creator/author
Reading a Book with Lee is described as a long-form
The basic premise is almost comically simple: Lee Sharks silently reads a book on camera for 57 minutes, with no narration, commentary, music, or camera cuts.
Sparrow Wells is listed as being affiliated with the Studio for Patacinematics
The archive describes the work as a deliberately unusual experiment in attention, duration, and observation.
